div.p: A preset the admin defines. Each course uses one.

ul.li: Flexible: full refund until 3 days before start, then 50%
Moderate: full refund until 7 days before start, then 50%
Strict: full refund until 14 days before start, then 0%
Cancelling before the run is Confirmed always gets a full refund.
If the platform cancels a run, everyone gets a full refund.
Percentages apply to what the customer actually paid.
